mapper.sql: select history.tenant_id, history.member_id, history.order_no, history.city_name from ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history history inner join ( select tenant_id, member_id, order_no, max(recipient_history_id) as recipient_history_id from ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history where is_delete = 0 group by tenant_id, member_id, order_no ) latest on latest.recipient_history_id = history.recipient_history_id where history.is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(1) as order_count, coalesce(sum(o.rent_amount), 0) as rent_amount, sum(case when o.order_status = 50 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_order_count, sum(case when o.order_status in (60, 65) or cast(o.time_effect_status as char) in ('1', 'overdue') then 1 else 0 end) as overdue_order_count from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where and o.create_time >= #{beginTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by date(o.create_time) order by date(o.create_time)

select coalesce(nullif(trim(recipient.city_name), ''), '未解析城市') as city_name, count(distinct o.order_id) as order_count, coalesce(sum(o.rent_amount), 0) as rent_amount, count(distinct case when o.order_status = 50 then o.order_id end) as completed_order_count, count(distinct case when o.order_status in (60, 65) or cast(o.time_effect_status as char) in ('1', 'overdue') then o.order_id end) as overdue_order_count from ry_business.ry_rental_order o left join (
) recipient on recipient.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and recipient.member_id = o.member_id and recipient.order_no = o.order_no where and o.create_time >= #{beginTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by coalesce(nullif(trim(recipient.city_name), ''), '未解析城市') order by order_count desc, city_name limit 100

select coalesce(nullif(trim(product.model_name), ''), nullif(trim(json_unquote(json_extract(o.package_details_json, '$.modelName'))), ''), '未指定型号') as model_name, count(distinct o.order_id) as order_count, coalesce(sum(coalesce(oi.quantity, 1)), 0) as quantity, count(distinct case when o.order_status = 50 then o.order_id end) as completed_order_count, count(distinct case when o.order_status in (60, 65) or cast(o.time_effect_status as char) in ('1', 'overdue') then o.order_id end) as overdue_order_count from ry_business.ry_rental_order o inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi on oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and oi.member_id = o.member_id and oi.order_id = o.order_id and oi.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_product product on product.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id and product.member_id = oi.member_id and product.product_id = oi.product_id and product.is_delete = 0 where and o.create_time >= #{beginTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by coalesce(nullif(trim(product.model_name), ''), nullif(trim(json_unquote(json_extract(o.package_details_json, '$.modelName'))), ''), '未指定型号') order by order_count desc, model_name limit 100
